description: This file contains unit tests for HTTP client functions and services related to trips and itineraries in a travel planner front-end project, using Jest testing framework.

methods.name: test('prepends baseUrl for relative paths and sends JSON body')
methods.description: Tests that the HTTP client correctly prepends base URL and sends JSON payload.

methods.name: test('handles non-JSON response')
methods.description: Tests that the HTTP client correctly handles responses with non-JSON content.

methods.name: test('throws TimeoutError on timeout')
methods.description: Tests that the HTTP client throws a TimeoutError if a request times out.

methods.name: test('throws HttpError on non-ok')
methods.description: Tests that the HTTP client throws an HttpError response for non-OK HTTP status codes.

methods.name: test('list calls /api/trips with paging')
methods.description: Checks that TripsService.list constructs correct URL with paging parameters.

methods.name: test('getById, create, update, remove call correct endpoints')
methods.description: Verifies that all TripsService methods call the appropriate endpoints.

methods.name: test('list calls /api/trips/:id/itinerary with optional day')
methods.description: Ensures ItineraryService.list constructs URL with optional date parameter.

methods.name: test('add/update/remove endpoints')
methods.description: Confirms that ItineraryService methods call the correct REST endpoints.
